claims.gist: By 2025, 70% of organizations will shift focus from big to small and wide data
COVID-19 made historical data obsolete, breaking production AI and ML models
Small and wide data make analytics and AI more robust and less big-data dependent
Small and wide data could serve demand forecasting, personalization and fraud detection
D&A leaders must turn to small and wide data techniques

thesis: By 2025 most organizations will shift to small and wide data, making AI less data-hungry and more robust.
